Wallpaper regions and subscriptions come from the wallpaper service; the launcher request is its last window state, not this page’s foreground. Self-healing status is verified live through the native launcher channel.
Wallpaper app updates can leave the launcher permanently unbound

When the wallpaper app (com.miui.miwallpaper) updates or restarts while Home stays alive, HyperOS Home’s native client attempts only one reconnect and has no lazy rebind. If that attempt fails or times out during the update, status bar contrast stays frozen at the pre-disconnect state across dark mode or wallpaper changes.

KeiHome adds native backoff retry and lazy rebind so Home automatically restores its wallpaper listeners after updates. Because both Home and Wallpaper update frequently, if self-healing ever becomes inactive or contrast breaks again, tap Copy diagnostics to report (restarting Home temporarily restores contrast).

Briefly refreshes system appearance, then restores the mode service’s current configuration. Your selected mode, automatic schedule and theme are preserved. Return Home afterward to check readability.
